query: ACTB gene CRISPRi knockdown perturbation function

results.title: ACTB (beta-actin) is a housekeeping gene critical for cell structure
results.content: ACTB encodes beta-actin, a cytoskeletal protein essential for cell motility and structure. CRISPRi knockdown of ACTB in K562 cells causes significant disruption to the cytoskeleton. ACTB is commonly used as a housekeeping gene in qPCR normalization, though its stability varies across conditions. Perturbation of ACTB can trigger apoptosis and cell cycle arrest.

results.title: Perturbation of housekeeping genes in single-cell CRISPRi screens
results.content: Housekeeping genes including ACTB, GAPDH, and B2M are frequently used as controls in CRISPRi experiments. Knockdown of these genes can activate the dna damage response pathway and induce apoptosis. Researchers observed interferon response activation when ACTB is perturbed in leukemia cell lines.
